_comment: Schema-type catalogue for TPPES / IOM switchgear drawings. A schema type is what a cubicle IS -- the device stack, the required inputs, and (once built) the SLD / three-line / DC cells that render it. 'source' records where the definition came from: 'TPPES' means the engineer specified it, 'drawing' means it was reverse-engineered from an issued sheet and needs confirming. 'requires' are the intake fields that must be filled for that type; 'optional' may be blank. Field names match the columns of the Units tab.
_revision: Rev B -- incorporates TPPES answers to the five open questions.

_status_legend.defined: device stack exists in sld_config.json -- build_sld.py can draw it today
_status_legend.specified: TPPES has specified the type; the device stack still has to be built
_status_legend.proposed: reverse-engineered from an issued drawing; needs TPPES confirmation

field_glossary.tag: Device tag, e.g. 52-GEN1A. Unique within the lineup.
field_glossary.schema_type: Which entry in this catalogue the cubicle is.
field_glossary.status: Blank for a normal in-service feeder, or SPARE / FUTURE. The two words mean the same thing; the drawing prints whichever is entered.
field_glossary.relay_2: Second relay, where the cubicle carries one. On an incomer this is the bus differential, e.g. SEL-787.
field_glossary.relay_functions: ANSI device numbers shown in the relay box, e.g. 25, 50P, 51P, 50G, 51G.
field_glossary.ct_protection: Protection CT ratio and quantity, e.g. 400:5A (3).
field_glossary.ct_metering: Metering CT ratio and quantity. Present only where a metering relay is specified.
field_glossary.ct_ground: Separate ground-fault / core-balance CT ratio. Motor feeders only.
field_glossary.pt_connection: PT connection -- open delta (usual) or wye-wye.
field_glossary.pt_reference: What the PT secondary feeds, e.g. LINE PT REFERENCE TO INTELIMAINS RELAY IN MCP.
field_glossary.cable: Incoming / outgoing cable size and quantity, e.g. 750kcmil (1)/PH.
field_glossary.destination: Source or load text printed at the cubicle entry / exit.
field_glossary.arrester: Surge arrester rating. Blank where the lineup has none.
field_glossary.deck: single / upper / lower, for two-high cubicles.

project_fields._comment: Supplied once per job, not per unit. available_sc_current is called out by the Incoming Power spec but is a property of the installation, not of any one cubicle.

motor_feeder.title: Feeder 2 - Motor Feeder
motor_feeder.description: Supplies a motor. Feeder breaker with motor protection relay, phase CTs and a separate ground-fault CT.
motor_feeder.notes: Only type in the catalogue with a separate ground-fault CT -- ct_ground exists for this. ct_metering is filled only when the customer specifies a metering relay (TPPES, confirmed). SEL-710 is new to the relay vocabulary.

utility_incoming.title: Incoming Power
utility_incoming.description: Utility supply into the switchgear. Main breaker with phase CTs for protection and metering, three VTs with secondary protection, and the incoming cable connection. Fit relay_2 where a bus differential is required.
utility_incoming.notes: Absorbs what was proposed as a separate 'utility_main_787' type. A bus differential is an option on this type, not a type of its own: enter the differential relay in relay_2 and its CT in ct_metering. 8372 unit 12 is this type with relay_2 = SEL-787. Available short-circuit current is a project-level input, held in the header rather than on the row.

customer_feeder.title: Feeder 1 - Customer / load feeder
customer_feeder.source: sld_config.json (8508), confirmed by TPPES as Feeder 1
customer_feeder.description: Generator feeder plus a control transformer. This is the type TPPES numbers 'Feeder 1'.

bess_feeder.title: BESS feeder
bess_feeder.description: Generator feeder plus a second fuse.

xfmr_feeder.title: Transformer feeder
xfmr_feeder.description: Fused disconnect with Kirk key, one CT, and the load-side transformer / panel cascade.

xfmr_riser.title: Transformer feeder continuation
xfmr_riser.description: Same disconnect, Kirk key and CT, terminating rather than cascading.

pt_riser_tie.title: Bus PT / riser adjacent to a tie
pt_riser_tie.description: Its relay takes the differential CT from the tie unit.

pt_riser.title: Bus PT / riser referencing the other bus
pt_riser.description: Differential CT comes from the other bus, on another sheet.

main_tie.title: Main / tie breaker
main_tie.description: Three CTs, two CPT fuses, breaker stack lowered to clear the tie run.

main_with_bus_pt.title: Main breaker with bus PT in the same cubicle
main_with_bus_pt.description: Main breaker with a bus PT tapped off the same riser above the bus, through a current-limiting fuse.
main_with_bus_pt.notes: On 8372 the PT secondary feeds TO ENGINATORS FOR SYNC REFERENCE.

gen_with_line_pt.title: Generator feeder with line PT in the same cubicle
gen_with_line_pt.description: Generator breaker plus a line PT on a separate fused riser. The PT is housed here but belongs electrically to the incomer in the adjacent cubicle.
gen_with_line_pt.notes: Needs a cross-reference to the cubicle the PT actually serves.

cubicle_arrangements._comment: Not schema types. A schema type says what a cubicle contains; an arrangement says how cubicles are subdivided. Any schema type can sit in any arrangement.

single_high.description: One unit per cubicle. Every issued drawing reviewed so far uses this for generator and main cubicles.

two_high.description: Two breakers stacked in one cubicle, each taking its own schema type. One row per deck, both rows carrying the same unit number.
two_high.blocked_by: Role positions in sld_config.json are absolute sheet elevations, so a deck offset cannot be expressed. Needs the slot refactor.

resolved: Feeder 1 is customer_feeder. Confirmed by TPPES.
FUTURE and SPARE mean the same thing. 'future_feeder' has been removed as a schema type -- it is now the status field on any feeder type, and the sheet prints whichever word is entered.
The utility main with an 87 differential is not its own type. 'utility_main_787' has been folded into utility_incoming, with the differential relay entered in relay_2.
Motor feeders carry metering CTs only when the customer specifies a metering relay, so ct_metering is optional on that type.
PT connection is usually open delta, sometimes wye-wye. Both are offered; open delta is the default.
open_questions: Motor feeder: is the ground-fault CT a core-balance (zero-sequence) CT, or residual from the phase CTs? Changes the symbol and the three-line.
Does SEL-710 need its own relay-box block, or does the existing relay box take any model as text?
Two-high: does the upper deck always sit on the line side and the lower on the load side, or does it vary by job?
